learning_outcomes.text: Students know the fundamental topics of quality management as well as the terminology, application possibilities, and limitations of quality management systems in companies. They can identify and describe the methods and tools relevant to a problem.

Students relate the tasks of quality management to known activities in the development and production of mechanical engineering products and integrate the application of quality management methods and tools into these activities.
Students can interpret the results of applying quality management and statistical methods and tools and derive measures for quality improvements.
Students apply the module's knowledge to practice-oriented tasks such as implementing a quality management system, evaluating measurement data, or determining the causes of quality problems.
Students cooperate with each other in processing practice-oriented tasks. They present and discuss their own results and those of others.
Students recognize the importance of quality management for their professional actions and question their activities in relation to the resulting requirements.

syllabus_topics: Significance of quality and quality management for companies
Elements of a quality management system
Structure, principles, and contents of QM systems according to DIN EN ISO 9000ff etc.
Quality management in the product life cycle from planning through production to use
Application of statistical methods (basics, evaluation of measurement series, Statistical Process Control (SPC), capability studies (MFU, PFU, MSA))
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are as specified in the currently valid study regulations.
